ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. First session is face-to-face, room TBA. An introduction to contemporary visual culture in the United States and to major theoretical perspectives on visually, mass communication, consumer culture, new media and digital technologies. Students will develop their capacity to interpret images from a variety of critical viewpoints.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
